_comment_file: This is the universal JSON format for drawing blocks. Use this structure for ALL block types.
_comment_usage: Adapt field values based on block type (topics, components, commands, procedures, tools, filter)

tool_calls._comment_block: Each object in tool_calls array represents one block in the diagram
tool_calls._comment_id: Unique number for this block (1, 2, 3, ...). Increment for each block.

params._comment_params: Contains all configuration for this block
params.name: block_name
params._comment_name: Block name in snake_case (use underscores, NO spaces). Examples: 'arduino_uno', 'top_cities', 'git_clone', 'step_1_prepare'
params._comment_username: The name of the user who created the block. Copy verbatim — do NOT modify.
params._comment_block_id: Unique string ID. Ranges by type: topics=100+, components=200+, commands=301+, procedures=401+, tools=501+, filter=801+
params._comment_block_type: Use canonical block types: 'tools', 'topics', 'commands', 'components', 'procedures', 'devices', 'memory', 'selection', 'filter'. See _block_type_specifics for exact required ports and params for each type.
params.description: Short human-readable description of what this block does.
params._comment_description: One-line description for the block. Used in UI and tooltips.
params._comment_filter_type: Only for block_type 'filter'. Must be one of: text, picture, video.
params._comment_folder_path: Path to the block folder. Format: data/{user_or_library}/{project}/{block_type}/{category}/{block_name}. Always use the data/... form; the app resolves the absolute location automatically regardless of build or deployment layout.
params._comment_bear: Optional. Relative path 'category/diagram_name' of the nested diagram saved in this block's bear workspace. Set automatically when user saves a diagram inside a bear window. Omit if no bear diagram exists.
params._comment_tags: Optional. String array of lowercase snake_case category/search tags (e.g. ['travel', 'europe', 'top_cities']). Omit if no tags are needed.
params._comment_x: Horizontal position in pixels. Space blocks ~200-500 apart (0, 200, 400, 600, ...)
params._comment_y: Vertical position in pixels. Use 0 for linear flows, different values for branching
params._comment_width: Block width in pixels. Default 400. Increase for blocks with many ports or long names.
params._comment_height: Block height in pixels. Default 400. Increase for blocks with many ports.

input_ports._comment_input: Input ports receive data. Each port needs 3 fields.
input_ports._comment_port_content: For INPUT ports: use empty string '' unless there is initial content to provide
input_ports._comment_port_path: MUST follow exact format: For topics/tools/commands/components/devices: 'data/{block_type}/{category}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt' | For procedures: 'data/procedures/{procedureName}/{stepName}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt' | For memory/selection/filter: 'data/{block_type}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt'

output_ports._comment_output: Output ports produce data. Each port needs 3 fields.
output_ports.port_content: Detailed description or content extracted from analysis
output_ports._comment_port_content: For OUTPUT ports: provide detailed, useful content. This is the actual data produced.
output_ports._comment_port_path: MUST follow exact format: For topics/tools/commands/components/devices: 'data/{block_type}/{category}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt' | For procedures: 'data/procedures/{procedureName}/{stepName}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt' | For memory/selection/filter: 'data/{block_type}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt'

params._comment_arguments: Maps input port names to sources. Format: {'port_name': 'block_name/inputs/port_name'} OR {'port_name': {'fromBlockName': 'source', 'fromPort': 'port'}}

tool_calls._comment_block_2: Example of a second block to show multiple blocks structure

params.name: another_block
params._comment_x_spacing: Space this block 400 pixels from the previous one

input_ports._comment_connection: This port can receive data from the first block's output

connections._comment_connection: Connections link output ports to input ports between blocks
connections._comment_from_block: Name of the source block (must exist in tool_calls)
connections._comment_from_port: Name of the output port from source block
connections._comment_from_path: Full path to the source output port file
connections._comment_to_block: Name of the destination block (must exist in tool_calls)
connections._comment_to_port: Name of the input port on destination block
connections._comment_to_path: Full path to the destination input port file

_CRITICAL_RULES._comment_rules: These rules MUST be followed when generating JSON
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_1_structure: ALWAYS include both 'tool_calls' array and 'connections' array at root level. Valid block_type values: topics, components, commands, procedures, tools, devices, memory, selection, filter.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_2_naming: Block names and port names MUST use snake_case (underscores, NO spaces)
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_3_ports: Every port MUST have exactly 3 fields: port_name, port_content, port_path
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_4_paths: Port paths MUST follow format: For topics/tools/commands/components/devices: data/{block_type}/{category}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt | For procedures: data/procedures/{procedureName}/{stepName}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt | For memory/selection/filter: data/{block_type}/{block_name}/inputs|outputs/{port_name}.txt
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_5_output: Return ONLY valid JSON - no markdown (```), no explanations, no extra text
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_6_closing: ALL brackets [ ] and braces { } must be properly closed
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_7_comments: When generating responses, REMOVE all '_comment' fields
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_8_content: Input ports: empty ''. Output ports: detailed content
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_9_description: ALWAYS include params.description: one-line human-readable description of what the block does.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_10_folder_path: ALWAYS include params.folder_path: path to block folder. Format data/{user_or_library}/{project}/{block_type}/{category}/{block_name}. Always use the data/... form; the app resolves the absolute location automatically.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_11_bear: Include params.bear ONLY when a nested bear diagram exists for this block. Value format is 'category/diagram_name' relative to the block's diagrams/ sub-folder. Do NOT invent a value — this field is set automatically by the application.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_12_size: ALWAYS include params.width and params.height (integers, default 400). Increase width/height to reflect block complexity — wider for blocks with many ports or long port names.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_13_username: ALWAYS copy params.username exactly as given in the context. NEVER invent, change, or omit it.
_CRITICAL_RULES.rule_14_tags: Optional params.tags: string array for categorization (e.g. ['travel', 'europe']). Omit the field entirely if irrelevant. Values must be lowercase snake_case.

_block_type_specifics.topics: block_id: 100+, path: topics/{category}/{name}. REQUIRED input ports: [description]. REQUIRED output ports: one per entity (port_name = entity name in snake_case, port_content = description of entity). Do NOT add a sibling key named 'topics' on the tool call object.
_block_type_specifics.components: block_id: 200+, path: components/{group}/{name}. REQUIRED input ports: description, connection, example_projects, integration. REQUIRED output ports (all 12): description, requirements, tutorials, type, manufacturer, datasheet, schematics, example_projects, price, location, connection, integration.
_block_type_specifics.commands: block_id: 301+, path: commands/{package}/{name}. REQUIRED input ports: description, plus one port per command parameter. REQUIRED output ports: description, result.
_block_type_specifics.procedures: block_id: 401+, path: procedures/{procedureName}/{stepName} (NO category — has procedure and step levels). Step naming: step_{number}_{descriptive_name}. REQUIRED input ports: sequence, dependencies. REQUIRED output ports: sequence, description, difficulty, dependencies, requirement, duration. x spacing: 500px between steps.
_block_type_specifics.tools: block_id: 501+, path: tools/{category}/{name}. REQUIRED input ports: description (reserved, always first), any task-specific inputs, code (reserved, always last). REQUIRED output ports: always include ALL of results, errors, warnings, code, status, description, change, improvements — append them after any task-specific outputs. Never omit any of these 8 standard output ports.
_block_type_specifics.devices: block_id: 601+, path: devices/{category}/{name}. FIXED input ports (exactly these 5, no more, no less): description, device_id, command, text, file. FIXED output ports (exactly these 8, no more, no less): results, response, status, errors, terminal, file, warnings, improvements.
_block_type_specifics.memory: block_id: 701+, path: memory/{name}. REQUIRED param: memory_mode set to either 'snapshot' or 'sequential'. snapshot mode — REQUIRED input ports: description, input; output ports: [] (empty, populated dynamically at runtime). sequential mode — REQUIRED input ports: description plus at least one user-defined data port; REQUIRED output ports: output.
_block_type_specifics.selection: block_id: 751+, path: selection/{name}. REQUIRED input ports: description, criteria, plus at least one candidate input port representing items to choose from. REQUIRED output ports: selected, analysis.
_block_type_specifics.filter: block_id: 801+, path: filter/{name}. REQUIRED param: filter_type set to one of: text, picture, video. FIXED input ports (exactly these 4): description, code, criteria, input. FIXED output ports (exactly these 6): filtered, analysis, errors, warnings, improvements, code. The input 'code' port stores editable Python used by Run; the output 'code' port mirrors generated/regenerated/used code.
